description: Synthetic evaluation set for offline-rag-kit. The corpus and questions were written for this project and are released under the repository's MIT license. Questions marked 'lexical' share words with the answer passage; 'paraphrase' ones deliberately do not, to expose the limits of BM25.

questions.q: How long are nightly backups kept?
Which class must flights be booked in?
How much is reimbursed per night for a hotel in a major city?
How often must status page updates be posted for severity 1 incidents?
Within how many working days is the postmortem written?
What security training must new hires complete?
How long are server access logs retained?
How long are customer invoices retained?
How long must a release candidate be tested in staging?
Can I get my meals paid for when travelling?
What happens when a deployment goes badly wrong?
Who helps newcomers during their first months?
When must a person's private information be wiped?
